span.p:
SC-002 exception, must
Given The PRD set has 18 files. Thirteen sections are at pending and fail the authoring tools' check because they have no content yet. One section has a header that cannot be read.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: When The author opens the PRD set.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: The author opens the PRD set.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author sees all 18 documents in order, with the status of each.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author sees which section has a header that cannot be read, and the name of its file.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author reads the other 17 documents as usual.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Then The PRD set opens. All 18 documents are listed. The one unreadable section is marked as unreadable with its file name, and the 17 other documents can be read.
